cookieConsent.title: Cookie & Privacy Consent
cookieConsent.description: We use cookies and browser storage to deliver a better experience and analyze service improvements. You can contribute to performance improvements by consenting to optional analytics.
cookieConsent.essentialDescription: Required for basic site operation such as session maintenance, CSRF protection, and language settings. Cannot be disabled.
cookieConsent.analyticsDescription: Collects anonymized activity data to analyze visitor statistics and dwell time, optimizing user experience and service performance.
cookieConsent.multiDeviceDetailDescription: Per CNIL guidelines, your consent or refusal while signed in applies consistently across all your devices. You can update or revoke your consent anytime in Profile settings.
cookieConsent.dialogDescription: Review the purpose and policy of each category of cookies and trackers used on this service.
cookieConsent.functionalDescription: Support convenience features such as language preferences and display settings.
cookieConsent.multiDeviceNotice: When signed in, your cookie consent settings are synchronized across devices.
